description: Trigger: peering/rate_limit.rs get_bucket() parses the peer address string; on parse failure it falls back to IpAddr::V4(Ipv4Addr::UNSPECIFIED) (0.0.0.0). Bad behavior: all peers with unparseable addresses share a single rate-limit bucket. A legitimate peer connecting through a proxy or with an IPv6 address that fails parsing shares a rate budget with a malicious peer, allowing one to exhaust the other's budget. Also, 0.0.0.0 is never blacklisted meaningfully.
title: invalid peer address falls back to 0.0.0.0 bucket, conflating all bad-address peers
